# Verbs a role template teaches that the binary does not register yet, each
# with the reason and the TRIGGER saying when the line goes away.
#
# Read by scripts/templatecensus (make template-census, in check-fast).
# Format: VERB  # what it is. TRIGGER: when, and who removes this.
#
# A TRIGGER is required — the tool refuses an exemption without one. And an
# exemption that has done its job FAILS the census as stale, so the line
# cannot outlive its reason: when the command registers, this file must give
# it up in the same commit.
